title: Check a message, choose your next step
intro: An early information checker for messages about 90-day reporting in Thailand. It cannot decide your right to stay or work.
scope: Pilot topic: 90-day reporting and extension-of-stay messages. Other topics may remain unverified.
message: Paste a public message or notice
placeholder: Leave out names, phone numbers, addresses and document numbers.
image: Or choose a screenshot of a public notice
redact: Cover private details by dragging over the image. Only the image shown here will be sent.
consent: I have removed private details. I agree to send this message and the displayed image to Meta models through Vercel AI Gateway for this check.
privacy: Lift does not save your message, image or AI answer. The AI provider processes them to answer. Requests require no-training and zero-retention routing. Hosting providers process connection data. Results stay in this tab; downloads stay in your files.
checking: Reading the message and comparing sources…
sampleNote: This is a made-up example, not a real broker message or official notice. Press Check to run the AI.
error: The AI check could not finish. Your input is still here. Please try again later.
unavailable: AI access is unavailable. You can still open the official sources below. No result has been invented.
invalid: Add a message or image and confirm the sharing choice first.
rate: The pilot has reached its request limit. Please try again later or open the sources directly.
imageError: Choose a readable JPG, PNG or WebP image smaller than 12 MB.
draft: AI draft — not yet checked by a person
summary: What the message appears to say
facts: Details found in the message — not confirmed facts
sources: Official sources used for this pilot
offlineSource: Source could not be refreshed; it was not used as evidence.
expired: Source review is out of date; it was not used as evidence.
reviewNote: A person can edit the explanation and actions below. This is a local review workspace; it does not prove a qualified or independent reviewer has approved anything.
reviewConfirm: I compared this draft with the linked original sources.
saveReview: Keep my corrections in this tab
reviewed: Locally reviewed draft — reviewer identity and expertise are not verified
twoPass: Two AI passes: extract the message, then compare claims with a limited source collection. This is not a search of the whole internet.
limit: Do not rely on this draft to miss a deadline, pay a fee, travel, or decide whether you can stay or work. Confirm your situation with a trusted adviser or the relevant service.
readImage: Please review any text read from the image; unclear images can be misread.
sourceLanguage: The original sources are in English or Thai. The explanation is an AI draft in your selected language.
formsScope: Form names only. The page distinguishes TM.7 and TM.47; it does not establish anyone’s eligibility, deadlines, fees or work permission.
servicesScope: Services at one provincial office. This does not confirm requirements for a pink-card holder or any particular person.
